premises.text: Passwords remain a weak human-linked security point; existing SSO/IAM/password tools require new user habits or heavy IT integrations and often put secrets in the cloud as a single point of failure
premises.evidence_span: All of these tools put your sensitive information in the cloud, creating a single point of failure

premises.text: MyKey authenticates via phone swipe and fingerprint and pushes username, password, and 2FA tokens to the browser, with remote logout from connected devices
premises.evidence_span: push her username, her password, and even the additional SMS token for two-factor authentication, directly from her phone to her browser

premises.text: Admins get a real-time control plane to share, revoke, and grant access, provision accounts with privilege levels, set location/time/IP rules, and rotate passwords on demand or on schedule—without service-provider integrations
premises.evidence_span: a single ecosystem for sharing, revoking, and granting access

premises.text: Initial GTM targets medium-sized companies (10–50 users) with free for first five users then about $4.99 per additional user per month, later moving upmarket with custom integrations and on-prem
premises.evidence_span: targeting medium-sized companies that have between 10 and 50 users
